ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ

en: [1] He is Alone, without a partner, indivisible and distinct from all else. The only true deity, unique in His essence, attributes, and actions.
[2] He is absolute, perfect, complete, self-sufficient; the one eternally and constantly required and sought; all existence depend upon Him; all matters ultimately return to Him.

p.src: 112:3  He neither begets nor is He begotten,

en: He neither begets nor is He begotten,
u.src: 112:3  He neither begets nor is He begotten,

p.src: 112:4  and there is none comparable to Him.”[3]

en: and there is none comparable to Him.”[3]
u.src: 112:4  and there is none comparable to Him.”[3]

en: [3] The Prophet (ﷺ) says that reading this surah (surat al-Ikhlās) equals reading one third of the Qur’an. [Al-Bukhāri and Muslim]
